sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face a home fixture against Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite their recent loss, Sandbach remain strong league leaders and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches and arrive on a run of five losses in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, with both sides looking to arrest recent mixed form — Stafford have won just one of their last three while Dawley sit mid-table. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in a fixture between two mid-table sides competing for playoff positions. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, host Wednesfield Community on Saturday, with Casuals having won their last match while Wednesfield sit mid-table; the two clubs then meet again on Wednesday 7 October at Brereton Social, where Brereton host Wednesfield. In-form Bilston Town (17 points, three wins in last four) travel to Foley Meir, while Barnton host Shawbury United in a battle involving mid-to-lower table sides; Shawbury are in dire form with six consecutive losses. Crewe face Allscott Heath on Saturday as both teams struggle in the lower half, while Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills with both sides inconsistent. Finally, Widnes Town, pointless at the foot of the table, visit Brereton Social on Saturday as heavy underdogs against a side in mid-table, and Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in a clash between two struggling sides near the bottom of the league.
